def oracle(input):
    nums, k, x = input
    n = len(nums)
    ans = []
    i = 0
    while i + k <= n:
        freq = {}
        j = i
        while j < i + k:
            v = nums[j]
            freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
            j += 1
        items = []
        for v in freq:
            items.append((freq[v], v))
        items.sort(reverse=True)
        keep = {}
        t = 0
        while t < x and t < len(items):
            keep[items[t][1]] = True
            t += 1
        s = 0
        j = i
        while j < i + k:
            v = nums[j]
            if v in keep:
                s += v
            j += 1
        ans.append(s)
        i += 1
    return ans

def oracle(events):
    best_idx = events[0][0]
    best_dur = events[0][1]
    prev_time = events[0][1]
    i = 1
    while i < len(events):
        idx = events[i][0]
        t = events[i][1]
        dur = t - prev_time
        if dur > best_dur or (dur == best_dur and idx < best_idx):
            best_dur = dur
            best_idx = idx
        prev_time = t
        i += 1
    return best_idx
